neighbours.label: A moving body physically approaching or closing in on a target (swam to within, approached the, at close range), vs figurative approach and static location
fire: The wolf crept to within a few metres of the sleeping calf.
As the canoe drifted closer, the heron finally flew off the rock.
Two fighter jets flew to within a mile of the airliner over the sea.
The cat slowly approached the bird feeder through the tall grass.
Rangers warned that elephants charge when tourists approach them too closely.
The tug edged to within inches of the tanker's hull.
Seals often swim right up to divers who stay calm in the water.
From his blind, the hunter watched the elk walk to within twenty yards.
quiet: The new manager approached the staffing problem with patience.
The results arrived within a few days of the blood test.
Our cabin sits beside a small lake at the foot of the hill.
The council approached the question of parking in a careful way.
Two old oak trees stand in the corner of the churchyard.
She finished the report within an hour of the meeting.
A wooden bench rests against the wall of the library.
The museum is located on the main square of the town.

predictions: Fire items 0.3-0.8 on 'within' / 'approached' / 'range'; near misses under 0.25.
notes: Card peaks: close range, avoid it in time, approached by vessels, stop next to.
